rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Nabu Nisaba is a semantic code analysis framework that combines tree-sitter parsing with KuzuDB graph storage to create queryable representations of codebases across Python, C++, Java, and Perl. Built by y3i12, it features an MCP server that exposes tools for structural code navigation, call graph analysis, clone detection, complexity assessment, and impact analysis through Cypher queries, while the Nisaba component provides an augmented development environment with file windows, tool result management, and workflow automation. The implementation uses compressed symbolic representations and confidence-based relationship scoring to enable sophisticated code exploration workflows, making it useful for large-scale refactoring, technical debt analysis, security audits, and AI-assisted code understanding tasks.
